notes: I changed the model from "predict nothing" to: insert the letter `"i"` at index `len(s)//2` (the floor-middle of the string). This matches all six E1 outputs exactly (`abc123`→`abci123`, `level`→`leivel`, `Zebralower`→`Zebrialower`, the long sentence→`...ifunction...`, `bananaUPPER`→`bananiaUPPER`, `Zebra`→`Zeibra`).
